name: Granola
shortDescription: Meeting notes that sit alongside your calls. Free to start. Paid plans are on their site.
longDescription: Granola takes meeting notes. There is a $0 plan, and paid plans are $14 and $35 per month.
bestFor: Notes during meetings you are already in
People who want a desktop notepad more than a wiki
notIdealFor: A team wiki or long-term knowledge base
strength: The free plan covers meeting notes, and the paid plan starts at $14 per month.
weakness: Free meeting history is limited, so a longer archive needs the paid plan.

useCaseFit.meetings-knowledge: Takes meeting notes alongside your calls, and the free plan covers that.
